title: This Bird Eats Bones for Dinner. Its Stomach Acid Is Nearly pH 1

scenes.text: There's a bird that eats bones. Most of its diet is bone.
It's the bearded vulture, with a wingspan of up to nine feet.
It drops bones from a great height to smash them open.
Then it swallows the pieces whole.
Its stomach acid sits around pH one, close to pure hydrochloric acid.
A bird that eats the one thing every other animal leaves behind.

description:
Bearded vultures get roughly 80 to 90 percent of their diet from bone.
They drop bones from a great height to shatter them and swallow the pieces, helped by stomach acid with a pH of around 1.
What is the strangest thing you have ever eaten? Comment below.
first_comment: Would you rather be a bird that eats bones or a fish that never stops swimming? Tell us why.
